ms.promise:
All purported features of the bot and blockchain work and the l-earning Bazaar platform is live!Using this platform, anyone can be a teacher or student, and the community can learn points of experience about learning on Discord.
This allows the community to take classes on cardano and the SDGs.
It will also be possible to create learning materials with the community's input, which will improve the quality of the educational materials.
It will also provide a mechanism for teachers to earn money and for those who take the classes to earn money.
This will give the entire community an incentive to learn and strengthen the cardano ecosystem.
